Comment: PS3 daily scoring chain — triggered by EventBridge PS3 Gold Export Complete. Values pinned 25-Aug-2026: Model = the retained chicago-ps3-root-cause Model object (endpoint deleted under D-4, Model kept; pins model package v14). Scored prefix per PS3_GO_LIVE_GUIDE section 4. SNS = the shared alerts topic, which gained its first confirmed subscriber 25-Aug. All rules start DISABLED. The transform job name carries the execution name because SageMaker job names are unique per account+region forever, including names taken by FAILED jobs — a date-only name makes every same-day retry impossible. NOT READY TO ENABLE: LoadRDS still targets cubic-mars-ps3-v25-loader, which reads chicago/ps3_outputs parquet and is fenced against this scored prefix, and which signals failure by RETURNING statusCode 500 rather than raising - so it neither loads these scores nor fails the execution when it loads nothing. Build the scored-prefix loader and repoint this state before enabling any rule.

FailExecution.Cause: A stage of the PS3 daily scoring chain failed. The SNS notification above carries the error payload; any ps3-sfn-failed EventBridge rule will now fire because the execution status is FAILED, not SUCCEEDED.
